description:
Cast Elvish Fury with buyback by paying {4}{G}, targeting Biovisionary.
Vesuvian Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Elvish Fury, giving Biovisionary +2/+2 until end of turn and returning Elvish Fury to your hand.
Repeat one additional time.
Cast Elvish Fury by paying {G}, targeting Biovisionary.
Vesuvian Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Elvish Fury, giving Biovisionary +2/+2 until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
